title: Sine halo
summary: Pure sine, 0.8 s in and 3 s out. Glue that can never accidentally sound like a hit — the neutral pad.
notes: Pure sine, 0.8 s to arrive and 3 s to leave. The slow attack is the instrument: it means a pad can never accidentally sound like a hit, so it glues an arrangement without ever competing for the front of it. The long release is what makes a chord change a swell instead of a cut.
